clues: This city sits in an oasis in the north west of China. Crescent Lake and the Singing Sand Dunes rest in that green place.
Rain here is so scarce that it dries up fast in the air. Yet this dry land is one of the most sun-lit in all of China, with sun most days.
This town held a key crossroads on the old Silk Road. One road ran from India, by way of Lhasa, toward Mongolia and Siberia.
It guards the mouth of a thin pass through the hills. That pass runs straight to the old capitals in the heart of China.
The Mogao Caves near here are famed through the world. This town is best known for those old caves by its oasis.
